info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status API provides users with real-time information on the status of various telecom SIM cards. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve the current operational states of SIM cards, helping them to monitor and manage their telecom resources effectively. Common use cases include telecom administrators checking SIM availability, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and optimizing resources for enhanced performance. This API is particularly beneficial for service providers and enterprises managing numerous SIM cards.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the current status of the SIM. It provides information about the readiness and state of the SIM card, allowing users to verify its operational condition.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the SIM operations. It should contain the necessary parameters for the request as defined in the corresponding schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and status retrieved.
